answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens before its first vote counts, and the bond stays frozen for three epochs while peers grade its work. A public atlas lists every locked bond and the key that funded it, so splitting one balance across many fresh wallets shows up at once. An attacker wanting 100 fake voices ties up 50,000 tokens for that whole voyage of three epochs. An honest agent selling apples from its grove pays once: a clean bond is refunded in full when the wait ends.
